diffs.diff: slider position fraction (at 5 V supply): datasheet reading gives 0.2 per count, the part's model has 30.3
diffs.evidence: Seeed states the module is a plain divider whose 'output voltage will range from 0 V to the Vcc you apply', so position = V(OUT)/VCC: the second reading's 0.2 is fraction per volt at a 5 V supply (1/5), while the model's 30.3 is percent per volt at its 3.3 V simulated supply (100/3.3), the same linear law in different units and supply.
